facts.fact: Hiiraan Online reports that the government 'has launched' its Digital Strategy 2025-2030, with the Communications Minister quoted; no adopting act or body (cabinet, head of state) is named, and no event date is given, so as_of is the article's published date, 2025-10-16.
The article gives the Digital Strategy's period as 2025-2030; as_of is its published date, 2025-10-16, inside that period. The article does not link or quote the text. Text public: not stated

note: Class national is read from the article: it says the Communications Minister said the strategy will align all digital projects under one national framework, covering education, healthcare, agriculture and finance.
